contributions.anchor: BOX B 'Contributions Received this Period' (9396.50) on the SUMMARY PAGE, which on this modern_boxAF filing is the LAST page (p4, located by its printed heading 'Summary Page'); the same 9396.50 is Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' AND its 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)', and it is repeated in Box F 'Subtotal before Expenditures (Box A + Box B)' because Box A is zero
contributions.detail: 13 Schedule A rows sum to 100 + 500 + 250 + 100 + 1000 + 275 + 1000 + 200 + 50 + (-328.50) + 2000 + 2000 + 2250 = 9,396.50 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed total = Box B. THE SUM INCLUDES ONE NEGATIVE ROW: 'Costco Reimbursment' -328.50, printed with a leading minus sign, and the side closes only with the sign preserved (as a positive it would give 10,053.50). Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints the SAME 9396.50 because this is the filer's first report of the cycle, so period equals year-to-date and no cumulative/period distinction arises; Box C is never summed as an increment regardless. The ladder corroborates: Box A 0 + Box B 9396.50 = Box F 9396.50, minus Box D 9266.96 = the balance-at-close box 129.54 exactly as printed.

expenditures.anchor: BOX D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (9266.96) on the p4 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 9266.96 and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report)' 9266.96
expenditures.detail: 15 Schedule B rows sum to 605.16 + 2000.00 + 567.20 + 1152.93 + 1154.50 + 1025 + 10 + 71.32 + 225 + 600 + 80.43 + 46.55 + 68.83 + 1640.90 + 19.14 = 9,266.96 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Box D. Box E (Year to Date) prints the same figure for the same first-report reason and is never summed.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable on this filing - tested both ways per ADDENDUM G1 and they give the same sum: the v.4.20 form prints no in-kind column and no in-kind line, no row is marked in-kind, and no contribution is mirrored by an equal offsetting expenditure. Both sides close on the monetary-only reading, which is also the monetary-plus-in-kind reading.
itemized.escalation_note: None needed: the whole filing is a born-digital fillable form (v. 4.20) whose figures are machine-set type, cleanly reproduced at 200 dpi and confirmed by 900 dpi cell crops. Both sides close to the cent.

itemized.notes: Andrea Allen, Utah County RECORDER, 2020 cycle - and THIS IS THE FIRST modern_boxAF FILING OF THE WAVE, so the form is characterised here in full. index.csv names 'Andrea Allen' and the page face agrees. Report type: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' (radio button filled), amendment = No (radio filled), report date 6/23/20, clerk stamp '20 JUN 23 PM 3:47. Single report, no bundle. ===== FORM CHARACTERISATION (v. 4.20, printed in the page footer) ===== The blank is a BORN-DIGITAL FILLABLE PDF issued by the Elections Division under Clerk/Auditor Amelia Powers Gardner, printed, signed and re-scanned; every figure is machine-set type, unlike the handwritten legacy era. FOUR pages: p1 cover / p2 Schedule A / p3 Schedule B / **p4 SUMMARY PAGE, which is the LAST page** - the opposite position from the legacy blank and exactly as the module's variant table predicts for modern_boxAF, but located here BY ITS PRINTED HEADING 'Summary Page', never by ordinal. NO CHECKLIST DECOY page is present in this filing. The summary boxes are lettered A (Balance at Beginning) / B (Contributions this Period) / C (Contributions Year to Date) / D (Expenditures this Period) / E (Expenditures Year to Date) / F (Subtotal before Expenditures = Box A + Box B), and the final box, 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)', is **UNLETTERED on this revision** - it is not lettered G. Box A is a typed '0', a numeral and not a nil mark, so it reads 0 under the zero-glyph ruling. THE SCHEDULES ARE FULLY BOXED GRIDS of 15 rows each, with the column headings printed in little tabs above the grid: Schedule A is 'Date / Name of Contributor / Address and Zip Code / Amount'; SCHEDULE B IS 'Date / Provider/Vendor / PURPOSE / Amount' - a REAL PURPOSE COLUMN, which no legacy_colAB blank in this corpus has, and 'Provider/Vendor' is the ADDENDUM H5 vocabulary now seen on the modern form. Each schedule prints TWO footers with DIFFERENT SCOPES - 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total ... (Sum of all Schedule A/B pages in this report)' - and on a one-page schedule they are equal; each page also repeats a small Name of Candidate / Date of Report / Page box at the foot, and THE 'Page' FIELD IS LEFT BLANK ON EVERY PAGE of this filing, so there is no foliation at all here. REDACTION: this file is doubly named '_Redacted_Redacted' and the county blacked out the candidate's SIGNATURE on the cover and the STREET portion of every donor address on Schedule A, leaving city/state/ZIP legible - except on Schedule A row 10 where the bar also covers the city. The bars are the document; nothing was reconstructed. Both sides reconcile EXACTLY on the promoted per-period boxes B and D.
